title: Visit every item with repeat for each
objective: Use repeat for each to visit every item of a list, add up values, and read fields of each record.

body.text: repeat for each in visits every item of a list in order. Each time round, the name you choose holds the current item. The loop ends after the last item, so you never have to count the items yourself. Lists are covered in the Data lesson.

body.title: Greet each name
body.code:
make names equal to a list of "Ana", "Bo", "Cy"
repeat for each name in names
    say "Hello, {name}!"

body.text: To combine the items, make a changing total before the loop and add to it inside. The say after the loop runs once, when every item has been added.

body.title: Add up a list
body.code:
make scores equal to a list of 10, 20, 30
make changing total equal to 0
repeat for each score in scores
    increase total by score
say total

body.text: The items can be records too. Read a field of the current item with its name, such as name of place. This works for any structure.

body.title: Visit each room
body.code:
structure room
    has name of type text

make rooms equal to a list of a room with name "entrance", a room with name "library"
repeat for each place in rooms
    say name of place

body.prompt: The program prints each number instead of their total. Make it print 6.
body.starter:
make numbers equal to a list of 1, 2, 3
make changing total equal to 0
repeat for each n in numbers
    say n
body.solution:
make numbers equal to a list of 1, 2, 3
make changing total equal to 0
repeat for each n in numbers
    increase total by n
say total
